note: RS 20 line (G0063 G0067 G0077 G0078 G0079 G0086 G0087 G0088 G0089): the Z9X profile with what the RS 20 stock differs in and the Z9X app can do. Stock source: newsettings release_838 of the official v1.6.55 package, trees settings_tree_product_athena* against settings_tree_product_dapeng (devices/_family/rs20/stock.tsv). Picture modes: the stock RS 20 list has no Standard (image_mode_standard is Z9X only), so the Z9X modes the RS 20 has. Zoom: the optical zoom of the stock zoom_and_optical_shift page (zoom.ini ZoomControlEn=1, ZoomLimitEn=0) without the limit position, since the RS 20 HAL has no zoom limit calls (hal/codes.tsv absent rows, Gmpf2Client.hasZoomLimit); the lens shift of that page has no Lumen code yet, and a firmware whose HAL lacks a zoom call gets the row off in its generated layer. Stock rows the Z9X app has no code for are not shown (stock.tsv gap rows).

off.picture.color_temp: the RS 20 stock colour temperature list is another node (image_mode_3_color_temp, not the Z9X image_mode_3_color_temp_dapeng); its values are not read yet
off.keystone.wall_color: the camera of an RS 20 is not read yet (devices/_family/rs20/wallcolor.conf)
